snippet.title: Cabernet - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Cabernet is out now on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PS5, PS4, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. Check out the Cabernet launch trailer for this 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th-century Eastern European-inspired world, with a modern twist. In Cabernet, guide Liza, a young vampire in her new unlife among the unsuspecting townsfolk. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?
